GainPilot works without a user account and without its own server. Everything you enter – meal plan, meals, weight, workouts, runs, supplements, goals and settings – is stored only locally in the app's storage on your device. We don't receive this data and can't see it. Exceptions are the optional leaderboard, the optional account with cloud backup and an optional Premium subscription (section 3).
GainPilot is a tool for planning nutrition and training. The app is not a medical device and does not replace medical, nutritional or sports medicine advice.

Each season lasts one calendar month. For each game your best result of the month counts (up to 40 points); the rating is the sum of all seven games, converted to 0–1000. Only rounds from real rest periods at the gym count. At the end of the month the final standings are recorded, then everything starts again.

Calorie needs, nutritional values, portion sizes, supplement amounts, training and running plans are guideline values and templates.
